decisive_spans.text: An anterior chamber paracentesis of the left eye yielded only acellular, dense, proteinaceous material

response.rationale: The presence of acellular, dense, proteinaceous material in the anterior chamber paracentesis strongly supports Primary central nervous system lymphoma (D9) and contradicts sympathetic ophthalmia (D8) and Uveitis due to Sarcoidosis (D4). While Lymphoma (D7) is a strong contender due to extensive lymphadenopathy and suspicion of malignancy, D9 is more specific given the paracentesis findings.
